'''Tasrin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
The criminal [[Kea Ra-Lan]] was once arrested by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces on this planet.<ref name="AJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
